layout: Three 3x2 effects sheets plus one 2x2 heroine sheet; normalized to engine frames.

prompts.lantern-blade: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for a 9:16 hand-painted dark fairy-tale card game. Deliver one 1536x1024 RGBA PNG animation sprite atlas: EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows, six square 512x512 cells, read left-to-right then next row. Transparent alpha background throughout; NO black/white/checkerboard backdrop, NO grid lines, NO borders, NO labels, NO numbers, NO writing, NO UI. Each frame confined entirely within its own cell with 10% empty margin, same anchor center (256,256), no light bleeding into neighboring cells. Paint soft irregular watercolor edges, luminous ivory core with colored rim, intricate brush-painted detail readable at 120 CSS pixels. This is a coherent six-frame time sequence of ONE effect, not six different illustrations. Subject: a sweeping crescent of golden lantern-light used as a magical blade, light only with NO literal weapon or human. Palette old gold #b08d3f, warm ivory #fff0ce, small ember-orange flecks. Frames: 1 a short thin curled light streak at lower left; 2 one curved diagonal upward sword-sweep growing toward upper right; 3 a wide dynamic crescent at impact with two slender parallel trails; 4 crescent breaks into elegant ribbons and sparks; 5 only trailing golden wisps and scattered sparks; 6 very few soft fading sparks. Main arc runs lower left to upper right, not a complete circle. Peak core occupies at most 76% of cell. No opaque smoke or giant white flash.

prompts.hero-actions: Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the identity/costume/style reference for the EXISTING HUMAN HEROINE of the game, not a background. Generate a production 1536x1024 transparent RGBA sprite atlas with EXACTLY 3 columns x2 rows, six 512x512 cells. Same young woman, short wavy dark brown hair with ONE pale gray streak, human face, navy hoodless cloak with gold cloud stitching and muted red lining, brown leather tunic/boots, round green jade pendant, satchel and red thread, ornate brass lantern. Preserve recognizability and costume. Painterly watercolor detailed fantasy illustration matching reference. Character faces slightly right. FULL BODY in each cell, same proportions and feet on local y=480, local horizontal anchor x=256; all body/cape/lantern within cell with 7% empty margin. Six action poses read left-right/top-bottom: 1 balanced ready stance holding lantern low; 2 wind-up lifting lantern across body and bending knees; 3 dynamic rightward lantern sweep with flowing cloak, free hand guiding light; 4 settled follow-through, cloak relaxing; 5 spell release, free palm toward right, other hand lifts lantern and a few short red threads curl near wrist; 6 defensive stance, lantern held in front of chest, free arm braced. NO sword, NO skeleton, NO skull, NO extra characters, NO floor, NO scenery, NO grid lines, NO frame labels/text, NO numbers, NO large magical effects outside body. Every surrounding pixel transparent, not a black/white background. This is a cohesive animation pose sheet, not a scene collage.
